name: terminal_manifest
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,datetime
lane=Path.cwd()
excluded={'MANIFEST.json','terminal_manifest.receipt.json','terminal_manifest.output.txt'}
files=[]
for p in sorted(lane.rglob('*')):
 if p.is_file():
  rel=str(p.relative_to(lane))
  if rel in excluded:continue
  assert not p.is_symlink()
  data=p.read_bytes();files.append({'path':rel,'bytes':len(data),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
after=json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text());assert not after['mismatches']
receipts=[]
for p in sorted(lane.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 if p.name=='terminal_manifest.receipt.json':continue
 q=json.loads(p.read_text());receipts.append({'path':p.name,'exit':q['exit'],'killed':q['killed']})
manifest={'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'files':files,'file_count':len(files),'completed_runner_receipts':receipts,'all_completed_receipts_hashed':True,'frozen_after':after,'ordinary':{'323710':'PASS','323059':'PASS'},'overall':{'323710':'HOLD','323059':'HOLD'},'acceptance':False,'credit':0,'campaign':'55/60 beyond39 unchanged','native_search_calls':1,'native_search_queries':3,'get_hops':3,'network':'STOP; publisher final unavailable, no retries','all_prior_jobs_reaped':True,'terminal_self_exclusions':{'MANIFEST.json':'self-hash would be circular','terminal_manifest.receipt.json':'runner emits this after this child exits; cannot hash its pending own receipt without circularity','terminal_manifest.output.txt':'runner emits this after child exits; output contains manifest hash, circular if included'},'no_later_frozen_writes':True,'resource_caveat':'Raw receipts authoritative; sampled RSS can miss transients, writer/native peaks unavailable. This terminal child will be synchronously reaped by immutable runner.'}
s=json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'MANIFEST.json'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
print(json.dumps({'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest(),'files':len(files),'completed_receipts':len(receipts),'frozen_bindings':after['count'],'mismatches':after['mismatches'],'ordinary':'both PASS','overall':'both HOLD','credit':0,'exclusions':sorted(excluded)}))
